newsitem.title: USA: X-Rite president Mat Peabody resigns.
newsitem.headline: X-Rite president Mat Peabody resigns.

text.p: X-Rite Inc said Wednesday President Mat Peabody had resigned.

"We wish him the best of success in all his future pursuits," said Ted Thompson, chairman and chief executive in a statement. "I am confident that the strength and experience of our management team will insure our continued success as we search for an individual to assume the role of president."
The company provided no further details about his departure. Peabody also was chief operating officer.

Earlier X-Rite, a provider of quality control instruments for paint, plastic and textile companies, said it earned $4.6 million, or $0.22 a share, in the second quarter, compared with $3.8 million, or $0.18 a share, in the same period last year.
